newsitem.title: USA: Summit Technology in class action suit.
newsitem.headline: Summit Technology in class action suit.

text.p: A class action suit against Summit Technology Inc was filed in U.S. District Court in Boston on Tuesday, attorneys for the plaintiffs said.
The firm of Savett, Frutkin, Podell & Ryan PC said the suit was filed on behalf of anyone who bought Summit call options or sold Summit put option between March 31, 1995, and July 3, 1996.

The suit alleges that Summit and five senior officers made materially false and misleading statements and omitted material facts concerning the marketing and selling of Summit's excimer lasers, the attorneys said. The statements and omissions caused damage to traders of Summit options during the class period, they said.
Summit officials could not immediately be reached for comment.
